purpose: Resolve the gauge ambiguity left explicit in the independent smooth v7.7 three-cut orbit-bijection family. Test all 32 exact orbit-bijective four-C4 openings and determine whether an accepted terminal orbit pair permits multiple relative S3 gains. It does not: every one of the 32 gadgets lifts to a bijection on the complete 18-state terminal space (orbit type tau, local S3 gauge g). Consequently networks consisting only of these deterministic wire atoms form a finite permutation/gain CSP solvable by propagation and cycle consistency; any remaining hardness must enter through a non-bijective boundary relation or through additional source-splicing constraints not captured by the wire equation alone.

terminal_state_space.state: s=(tau,g), where tau in {0,1,2} is the canonical C4 orbit type and g in S3 maps canonical colours to actual colours.
terminal_state_space.relative_gain_convention: For oriented terminals X->Y use h_XY=g_Y^{-1} g_X. Global colour symmetry allows g_X=id during finite replay.
terminal_state_space.transport_form: If the orbit permutation is pi and the unique relative gain at input orbit tau is h_tau, then for arbitrary left gauge g the exact right state is F(tau,g)=(pi(tau), g composed with h_tau^{-1}). Thus F is a permutation of all 18 terminal states.

exhaustive_result.parent_class: Exactly the k=3 smooth four-C4 hidden-saturated openings classified in the independent v7.7 artifact.

explicit_v7_7_control_lift.meaning: Internal hidden states branch, but the external full terminal state does not. This distinction is essential: hidden witness multiplicity is harmless for deterministic boundary propagation.

polynomial_backbone_theorem.language: Let a finite graph of abstract terminal variables carry constraints s_v=F_e(s_u), where every F_e is one of the exact 18-state bijections above; reverse traversal uses F_e^{-1}.
algorithm: For each connected component choose one root terminal state. Because the language is globally S3-equivariant one may either try the constant 18 root states or quotient by the common global colour action.
Propagate the unique state along a spanning tree using the edge permutations.
For every non-tree edge verify that the propagated endpoint states satisfy its permutation equation; equivalently check the finite holonomy around each fundamental cycle.
If a consistent root state exists, all terminal states are reconstructed uniquely relative to that root; hidden C4 witnesses are then recovered locally from the stored finite extension table.
polynomial_backbone_theorem.complexity: O(18*(|V|+|E|)) with constant-size permutation tables, hence deterministic polynomial time and linear in the abstract wire network size.
polynomial_backbone_theorem.consequence: Pure deterministic twisted-wire networks are not the hard core. Exponential branching cannot be justified by these wire atoms alone.

relation_to_parallel_v7_7_v7_8.parallel_rigid_NEQ: The separate source-open v7.7 rigid NEQ gadget has six allowed orbit pairs, each with one gain; it is non-bijective as an orbit relation and therefore is not one of the deterministic three-pair wires classified here.
relation_to_parallel_v7_7_v7_8.parallel_three_wire_collapse: The separate v7.8 theorem shows that naive three-copy source-open composition of that rigid NEQ gadget projects to FULL_3x3 and often loses all gain information. This does not contradict the present theorem: it demonstrates exactly why non-bijective splice relations, rather than bijective transport edges, are the next frontier.
relation_to_parallel_v7_7_v7_8.combined_frontier: Mix the deterministic 18-state permutation wires with the v7.8 non-universal gain-only boundary types of sizes 46, 50 and 52, while preserving concrete dangling ports and Hamiltonian path topology.

firewall: The polynomial theorem applies to the abstract network after each physical gadget has already been certified to impose exactly one full-state permutation equation. It does not prove that arbitrary such networks can be embedded into a single smooth Hamiltonian source graph.
External splice edges may add constraints beyond F_e and can destroy the deterministic-wire abstraction; every physical composition still requires exact port-level replay.
Hidden witness branching is not claimed unique and need not be; only the terminal full-state relation is functional.
No universal 3-COLOR or SAT algorithm is constructed and P versus NP remains open.

next_target.name: E8_GAIN_ONLY_46_50_52_ADAPTER_WITH_DETERMINISTIC_18STATE_WIRES_V7_10
next_target.directive: Use v7.9 deterministic wires only as polynomial transport/adapters. Take the 192 non-universal three-wire source-open topologies isolated by the parallel v7.8 artifact (boundary sizes 46,50,52), canonicalize those relations under terminal swap, orbit relabelling and global S3 gauge, and compose them with each of the ten v7.9 transport signatures at the exact dangling ports. Seek either (a) a relation-preserving source splice that reduces one gain-only type to a smaller non-bijective canonical atom, or (b) a finite closure theorem showing all such adapter compositions remain in a tractable permutation/coset language. Do not enumerate long networks; first quotient the constant relation catalog by symmetry and prove the composition rule.
